meta.method: GitHub REST API observations (repo meta, releases, README) for GitHub URLs; page observations for other hosts. Manual corrections in data/evidence-class-overrides.json win. Classes measure public evidence strength only; Class 0 is reserved for full software reconstruction cases.

rubric.0: A full software reconstruction case (kind: case-study) whose documentation covers the feature set, plus a download method and an image or video demo. Analysis tools, integrations, guides and other non-reconstruction entries stay at Class 1 even with complete evidence.
rubric.1: Download method and image/video demo exist, but the documented scope is partial, or the entry is not a full software reconstruction (tools, integrations, guides, binary-analysis entries); Class 3 evidence is never raised.
rubric.2: Demo or download missing; code and documentation exist, so buildability stays unknown.
rubric.3: No code or no documentation: progress notes or notebook entries only.
